invariants.rationale: 'size' should not be NaN, as it is used to set preferred dimensions and NaN would not be meaningful in this context.
Infinite values for 'size' would not make sense for preferred dimension settings and may cause errors when passed to Fixed.valueOf.
Preferred dimensions are typically non-negative; negative values would not be expected or safe for UI sizing.
Ensures 'size' is a finite float, combining not NaN and not infinite, for safe use in UI size context.
